newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bonn increases issue volume of Series 121 Bobl.
newsitem.headline: Bonn increases issue volume of Series 121 Bobl.

text.p: The German federal government will increase the issue volume of the series 121 5-year Bundesobligationen, or Bobl, by two billion marks the Bundesbank as issuing agent said on Friday.

The total volume size of the series after the top-up will be 16 billion marks. The Bundesbank will start selling the additional amount as part of its market tending operations starting April 9, the Bundesbank said.
The 121 Bobl series carries a 4.75 percent coupon and will expire November 20, 2001.
